Gemeente Doetinchem; Particulier; Staatsbosbeheer; Koninklijke Nederlandse Natuurhistorische Vereniging
Stichting Het Nationale Park De Hoge Veluwe
Drinking-water company area without a published mushroom rule (PWN: only blackberries in August in the Noordhollands Duinreservaat; Waternet: no damage or disturbance; Vitens: none). Check the signs.
Estate (landgoed): usually privately owned. Ask permission, unless an owner area shown on top says otherwise.
Landschap Noord-Holland tolerates 'a handful for own use' (stay on paths), but that text is about nuts and fruit; mushrooms are not mentioned in the tolerance.
Military land: access is restricted and no picking permission is known.
Municipal land. Rules depend on the municipal bylaw (APV), not yet checked.
Municipal street or park tree (from the municipality's tree register). The municipality's rules for public green apply; no picking policy is known.
National Park Zuid-Kennemerland: mushroom picking is completely forbidden.
National park with several owners. The rules of the owner areas inside it apply.
Owner unknown. Check the signs, or ask the owner.
Owner/manager known, but their picking policy has not been looked up yet.
Picking is not allowed. Collecting loose items along roads and paths is allowed (max. one mushroom tub per person, not commercial).
Private owner: picking needs the owner's permission.
Privately owned tree (owner in the municipal register): ask the owner.
Public park, usually owned by the municipality. The municipal bylaw on public green may apply.
Several managers with different rules: Brabants Landschap; particulieren. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Gemeente Den Haag; Duinwaterbedrijf Zuid-Holland; Zuid-Hollands Landschap. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Gemeente Doetinchem; Particulier; Staatsbosbeheer; Koninklijke Nederlandse Natuurhistorische Vereniging. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Natuurmonumenten; Limburgs Landschap; particulieren. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Natuurmonumenten; Waterschap Roer en Maas; Staatsbosbeheer; Rijkswaterstaat; particulieren. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Staatsbosbeheer; Het Zeeuwse Landschap; Rijkswaterstaat. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Staatsbosbeheer; Limburgs Landschap; Rijkswaterstaat. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Staatsbosbeheer; Natuurmonumenten; Domeinen. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Staatsbosbeheer; Zuidhollands Landschap. Check the signs.
Several managers with different rules: Staatsbosbeheer; particulieren. Check the signs.

Small-scale picking for your own use and at your own risk is tolerated: as a guide one 250 g mushroom tub. Large-scale or commercial picking counts as theft. Staatsbosbeheer does not encourage mushroom picking and points out that some municipalities forbid it by bylaw. Signs at the entrance prevail.
Tree in a garden: private ground, ask the owner.
Wild picking is allowed: stay on paths and roads, personal use only, at most a 250 g mushroom tub. No wood or branches.
Wild picking is not allowed in Natuurmonumenten areas ('even a little can harm vulnerable nature'); you risk a fine.
Wild picking only along roads and paths, about one mushroom tub, for your own use. Commercial picking and taking plants, wood or branches is forbidden.
Damaging, cutting, removing or possessing mushrooms is forbidden in National Park Loonse en Drunense Duinen. (Art. 14, Duinverordening gemeente Heusden 2025)
Picking flowers or mushrooms is forbidden in public parks, plantsoenen and municipally maintained green. (Art. 2:45 Bescherming groenvoorziening, APV gemeente Nijmegen)
Picking mushrooms is forbidden in nature areas owned by the municipality, and in areas the municipality designates (designations not found). (Art. 4:10 Plukverbod paddenstoelen, APV Nunspeet 2025)

Picking mushrooms is forbidden in the nature areas of Natuurmonumenten and Geldersch Landschap & Kasteelen, in the municipal forests Johannabos and Oosterbos, and in areas the municipality designates. (Art. 4:9a Plukverbod paddenstoelen, APV gemeente Barneveld)

Picking or possessing mushrooms is forbidden everywhere, except at places the municipality designates as allowed (none found). (Art. 2.10 Beschermde planten; hout sprokkelen, Verordening fysieke leefomgeving Ermelo)
Picking or possessing mushrooms is forbidden in the whole municipality. (Art. 7:8 Plukverbod paddenstoelen, Verordening Fysieke Leefomgeving gemeente Bergen (L) 2022)

Picking, removing or possessing any mushroom (all fungi) is forbidden in the whole rural area (buitengebied). (Designation decision art. 4.13 APV (protected plants), 2010, still listed as in force; current APV 2019 art. 4.20)

Picking, transporting or possessing mushrooms is forbidden in all municipal forests, plantsoenen, parks and (natural) verges, the Baarnse Bos, and the forest between Zandheuvelweg, Amsterdamsestraatweg, Biltseweg and the municipal border. (Art. 4:6 Beschermde planten: paddenstoelen plukken, Verordening fysieke leefomgeving Baarn)
Removing or possessing mushrooms is forbidden in forest areas. (Art. 4:20 B Verwijderen van paddenstoelen, APV gemeente Bronckhorst 2021)
Removing, possessing or selling any mushroom (all fungi) is forbidden in the whole municipality. (Art. 4:20 Planten, paddenstoelen, mossen, APV gemeente Elburg)
Removing, possessing or selling any mushroom (all fungi) is forbidden in the whole municipality. (Art. 7.35 Paddenstoelen en mossen, Verordening fysieke leefomgeving gemeente Epe 2026)
